confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Rome price levels for July 2026. No live menus, listings, or booking pages were consulted, and city anchors were not sourced by web search. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation anchors are least certain because rates vary widely by neighborhood, booking lead time, and peak-season demand. Cocktail and wine anchors rely on direct knowledge of Rome bar and restaurant pricing and were cross-checked against the beer anchor. USD anchors are approximate translations of typical local price levels.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other large Italian tourist cities such as Florence and Milan, adjusted for Rome's historic-centre restaurant prices and summer peak-season accommodation demand.
